text: {"thesis":"Bear/avoid case for RTSLAUSDT into the 2026-04-22 earnings catalyst: the recent move looks like a counter-trend bounce rather than a durable uptrend. Price is extended 5.8% above SMA20, yet SMA20 remains below SMA50, so the intermediate trend structure is still bearish. Momentum has decelerated sharply—20d momentum is +8.5% but 5d is only +0.3%—suggesting the pre-earnings advance has stalled and is vulnerable to a sell-the-news reaction. With ATR14 at ~4.0% of price, event volatility is elevated; mean reversion to SMA20 alone implies roughly 5.5% downside toward 369.71, and a 1-ATR adverse earnings move implies about a 15.8-point drop.
